layerGroup.name: MaC_3-15_SRW_tracking_divedepth
layerGroup.title: Interpolated tracking movements of Southern right whales from - maximum dive depth (NESP MaC 3.16)
layerGroup.abstractTxt:
This map package shows the interpolated positions of four southern right whales satellite tagged in Encounter Bay, SA in June 2024. Locations are predicted at six-hour intervals using a state-space model, together with dive metrics summarised for the three hours before and after each modelled location.
This layer is styled by the maximum dive depth for each six hour period, where dive data was available.
